messages:
Rachel: Quick thread 1  we should build a small multi-arch validation harness for partner ref-kits so we can gate marketplace publishes. Core pieces: terraform module smoke, metadata lint, and a tiny infra sanity test that runs on x86 and arm emulation.
Tom: agree. i'll prototype a GH Actions job that runs `terraform init` + `validate` and then a container-based emulation using qemu to run a small smoke container on arm. keeps infra fast.
Priya: i'll own the metadata lint & packaging schema. want a yaml schema that checks listing blurb length, icon resolution, license presence, and region table. will add a `metadata.yaml` example.
Zack: i can scaffold the harness repo layout: /.github/workflows/validation.yml, /examples/, /packaging/metadata.yaml, /tests/smoke/. will add a tiny terraform plan that uses a local provider stub so CI doesn't hit real cloud.
Rachel: good. for the emulation step, prefer using docker/setup-qemu-action + docker buildx so we can run an alpine-based smoke runner for arm. we shouldn't require cloud creds in CI.
Tom: here's a minimal GH Actions snippet i'll add to the PR:
```
name: multiarch-validate
on: [pull_request]
jobs:
  tf-smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - uses: hashicorp/setup-terraform@v2
      - run: terraform init -input=false
      - run: terraform validate
  arm-emul:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@v2
      - uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v2
      - name: build arm runner
        run: |
          docker buildx build --platform linux/arm64 -t orbit-smoke:arm --load ./tests/smoke
          docker run --rm orbit-smoke:arm ./run-smoke.sh
```
Priya: nice. i'll write a `packaging-lint` job to run `python -m jsonschema` against metadata.yaml and fail fast. also will include a small rule for `description.length <= 200`.
Zack: for terraform smoke, i'll add a `providers_stub.tf` and a plan that only creates local resources (null_resource) so `terraform plan` is meaningful without cloud creds.
Rachel: timeline: today agree owners (done). Tue - draft harness + schema. Wed - GH Actions wired and smoke container added. Thu - run the harness against two existing partner ref-kits (Orbit + Edge) in staging. Fri - final docs + gating rule in partner checklist.
Tom: i can open the harness repo PR tomorrow EOD. will add logging so we can see qemu output in GH Actions logs.
Priya: after schema ready i'll add `metadata.yaml` linter as a step in the module template so partners get lint feedback early.
Zack: i'll add `./tests/smoke/run-smoke.sh` that performs basic health-check calls against the local stub and returns non-zero on failure.
marketplace-copilot: NOTE: When the harness PR is opened, run `./tools/auto-gate add --check multiarch` to register the gating rule for partner staging.
Rachel: question: who will be the final sign-off for adding the gating rule? we need an owner to avoid accidental blockages.
Priya: i'll take sign-off for metadata gating. Tom can own the CI/emulation sign-off.
Tom: fine by me. i'll also add an opt-out flag for early-stage partners during onboarding so we don't block initial iterates.
Rachel: perfect. please link PRs in the partner tracker and tag me. :thumbsup:
Tom: will do. i'll prototype the qemu runner tonight.
Zack: i'll scaffold the repo and push examples/minimal and examples/full; will include README with quickstart (3 commands).
Priya: i'll publish the schema as packaging/metadata-schema.yaml in the harness repo.
marketplace-copilot: REMINDER: run `./scripts/validate-listing.sh` locally before requesting staging publish.
